import BanachIsometric.FiniteNerveClosedStar

/-! Actual nested finite carriers of subsets of a polyhedron. The carrier is
generated by all faces meeting the subset. If that subset lies in an open
vertex star, adjoining the vertex preserves its carrier faces, and the actual
carrier realization is contractible by an affine contraction. -/

noncomputable section
namespace BanachIsometric.FiniteNerve.Complex

variable {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

open scoped Classical in
def faceImageCarrier (K : Complex ι) (A : Set (ι → ℝ)) : Complex ι where
  faces := K.faces.filter (fun s => ∃ t ∈ K.faces,
    (∃ w ∈ A, w ∈ coordinateFace t) ∧ s ⊆ t)
  nonempty := fun s hs => K.nonempty s (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
  downward := by
    intro s hs u hus hu
    obtain ⟨hsK, t, htK, hw, hst⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hs
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨K.downward s hsK u hus hu, t, htK, hw, hus.trans hst⟩

theorem mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff (K : Complex ι) (A : Set (ι → ℝ)) (s : Finset ι) :
    s ∈ (K.faceImageCarrier A).faces ↔ s ∈ K.faces ∧
      ∃ t ∈ K.faces, (∃ w ∈ A, w ∈ coordinateFace t) ∧ s ⊆ t := by
  simp only [faceImageCarrier, Finset.mem_filter]

theorem faceImageCarrier_faces_subset (K : Complex ι) (A : Set (ι → ℝ)) :
    (K.faceImageCarrier A).faces ⊆ K.faces := by
  intro s hs
  exact ((K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A s).mp hs).1

theorem faceImageCarrier_mono (K : Complex ι) {A B : Set (ι → ℝ)} (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
    (K.faceImageCarrier A).faces ⊆ (K.faceImageCarrier B).faces := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, t, htK, ⟨w, hw, hwt⟩, hst⟩ := (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A s).mp hs
  exact (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff B s).mpr
    ⟨hsK, t, htK, ⟨w, hAB hw, hwt⟩, hst⟩

theorem subset_space_faceImageCarrier (K : Complex ι) {A : Set (ι → ℝ)}
    (hA : A ⊆ K.space) : A ⊆ (K.faceImageCarrier A).space := by
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hws⟩ := (K.mem_space_iff w).mp (hA hw)
  exact (mem_space_iff _ _).mpr ⟨s,
    (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A s).mpr
      ⟨hs, s, hs, ⟨w, hw, hws⟩, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩, hws⟩

theorem insert_mem_faceImageCarrier_faces (K : Complex ι) {A : Set (ι → ℝ)} (i : ι)
    (hA : ∀ w ∈ A, 0 < w i) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s ∈ (K.faceImageCarrier A).faces) :
    insert i s ∈ (K.faceImageCarrier A).faces := by
  obtain ⟨_hsK, t, htK, ⟨w, hw, hwt⟩, hst⟩ := (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A s).mp hs
  have hit : i ∈ t := by
    by_contra hi
    have hz := hwt.2 i hi
    exact (ne_of_gt (hA w hw)) hz
  have hist : insert i s ⊆ t := Finset.insert_subset hit hst
  exact (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A _).mpr
    ⟨K.downward t htK _ hist (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _),
      t, htK, ⟨w, hw, hwt⟩, hist⟩

theorem starConvex_faceImageCarrier (K : Complex ι) {A : Set (ι → ℝ)} (i : ι)
    (hA : ∀ w ∈ A, 0 < w i) : StarConvex ℝ (vertex i) (K.faceImageCarrier A).space := by
  intro x hx a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hxs⟩ := (mem_space_iff _ _).mp hx
  obtain ⟨_hsK, t, htK, ⟨w, hw, hwt⟩, hst⟩ := (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A s).mp hs
  have hit : i ∈ t := by
    by_contra hi
    exact (ne_of_gt (hA w hw)) (hwt.2 i hi)
  have hxt : x ∈ coordinateFace t := coordinateFace_mono hst hxs
  exact (mem_space_iff _ _).mpr
    ⟨t, (K.mem_faceImageCarrier_faces_iff A t).mpr
      ⟨htK, t, htK, ⟨w, hw, hwt⟩, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩,
      coordinateFace_convex t (vertex_mem_coordinateFace hit) hxt ha hb hab⟩

theorem faceImageCarrier_contractibleSpace (K : Complex ι) {A : Set (ι → ℝ)}
    (hA : A ⊆ K.space) (hne : A.Nonempty) (i : ι) (hi : ∀ w ∈ A, 0 < w i) :
    ContractibleSpace (K.faceImageCarrier A).space :=
  (K.starConvex_faceImageCarrier i hi).contractibleSpace
    (hne.mono (K.subset_space_faceImageCarrier hA))

theorem faceImageCarrier_rawPositiveHomology_subsingleton (K : Complex ι)
    {A : Set (ι → ℝ)} (hA : A ⊆ K.space) (hne : A.Nonempty) (i : ι)
    (hi : ∀ w ∈ A, 0 < w i) (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (SingularPrism.RawPositiveHomology (K.faceImageCarrier A).space n) := by
  letI := K.faceImageCarrier_contractibleSpace hA hne i hi
  exact SingularPrism.rawPositiveHomology_contractible _ n

end BanachIsometric.FiniteNerve.Complex
